evals.prompt: My site has routes like /texas, /texas/houston, /texas/houston/mold-remediation — no trailing slashes. Fix this to follow the canonical trailing-slash scheme. What files do I need to change?
evals.expected_output: Identification of the route files, canonical tag, sitemap URLs, og:url, JSON-LD URLs, and internal hrefs that need trailing slashes added. Should reference the exact patterns from the skill.

evals.prompt: Run the SEO check script on my dist/ folder and tell me what's broken.
evals.expected_output: The agent should describe running check-seo.js against dist/**/*.html, checking for missing title, meta description, canonical, JSON-LD, and OG tags, then reporting per-tag missing counts.

evals.prompt: I'm about to deploy. Walk me through the delivery gate — what scripts do I run and what does each check?
evals.expected_output: The full delivery gate sequence: npm run build (prebuild → Astro → fetchpriority → sitemaps), npm run validate (data sanity), npm run check:seo (0 issues), npm run check:wordcounts (per-type ranges), plus the 5-page random review and accessibility pass.
